name: live_input_node_from_graph
description: OSC-3a: a project declares one live input, a. The value.input dialog lists live:a beside the catalog's clock names; choosing it and pressing OK places a value.input whose parameters.name is exactly live:a, and the engine holds it. The scenario needs a real engine and Studio; the CPU tests cover the model and the dialog without one.
